episodes.synopsis: A spot has opened for Class 13 and Medaka has been invited to join. It won’t be that simple as other students of class 13 will fight for the spot and a chance to be a part of the Flask plan.
episodes.title: Normal, Special, and Abnormal

episodes.synopsis: Medaka is no match for the students of Class 13. The only way to power up is to visit a man that knows all her weaknesses.
episodes.title: Sister, Sister, Sister!

episodes.synopsis: Medaka and Zenkichi one day of training has paid off, somewhat. To stop the Flask Plan they will have to fight even more Class 13 students, but not without help.
episodes.title: Crush You Today!

episodes.synopsis: Medaka’s first opponent even catches her off guard with his abnormality. Medaka will have to push her body to the limit and speak with her fist to make it to the next floor.
episodes.title: The Monster I've Sought

episodes.synopsis: When every reason is a reason to kill, Munakata Kei cannot be stopped with words. Medaka is in no shape to take on such a killer, so it is up to her best friend to take on the killer.
episodes.title: You Can't Be Killed!

episodes.synopsis: Kouki has been separated from the group by code name: Black White. Black White offers him a deal, while code name: Best Pain attempts to assassinate him.
episodes.title: Please Become My Something

episodes.synopsis: With some advice from Maguro, Akune might have a chance winning against Best Pain. Maguro himself is more interested in Black White aka Naze Youka.
episodes.title: Kurokami Kujira is a Lovely Name

episodes.synopsis: Things aren’t looking well for Student Council, the members are hurt and Medaka is incapacitated. To make matters worse, a new group of 13 students have offered their help to Supervisor Naze.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to See You Cry

episodes.synopsis: With Akune and Hitoyashi knocked out, Kikaijima is the only one left to challenge Yukuhashi, who seems to be able to read her mind.
episodes.title: Kurokami Medaka (Rev)

episodes.synopsis: Medaka-chan is gone; there is only Kurokami Medaka (Rev). The first act of Medaka (Rev) is to disband the Student Council, marry Oudo, and complete the Flask plan.
episodes.title: How to Please Everyone

episodes.synopsis: While Medaka battles it out with Oudo, Naze begs her brother to fix Koga and promises to do anything he wants.
episodes.title: That's All She Wrote!

episodes.synopsis: The story of Medaka continues but the writers are saving that for another time. Enjoy this bonus story of everyone’s favorite loser.
episodes.title: Good Loser Kumagawa, -12th Tank. Execute the Student Council
